item.title: Olympic skater Ilia 'Quad God' Malinin shares petition to save Lloyd Center ice rink
item.description: Ice skaters and Olympic champion Ilia Malinin are rallying to save the Lloyd Center ice rink in Portland, which has been part of the community since 1960, from being torn down by developers.

item.title: Clackamas County corrections officer charged with sexual misconduct, other victims sought
item.description: Paul Eric Alexander Schultz, a community corrections officer at the Clackamas County Sheriff's Office, is facing charges related to sexual misconduct after allegedly engaging in sexual contact with a corrections client on Jan. 11.
